client_summary: string - 3 to 5 sentences: overall support picture for the period

recurring_issues.title: string - short name of the recurring problem
recurring_issues.ticket_count: integer - number of tickets in this cluster
ticket_numbers: string - ticket numbers that belong to this cluster
recurring_issues.category: string - one of: backup, endpoint, network, identity, email, security, application, hardware, other
recurring_issues.likely_root_cause: string - most likely underlying cause, or 'unclear' with how to confirm

proactive_opportunities: string - preventive improvement or service suggestion
documentation_notes: string - facts worth adding to the client's documentation (environment, recurring procedures, known issues)
